core_entities.name: Child
core_entities.description: Represents a child enrolled in the daycare, including personal details, enrollment status, and associated guardians.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the child.

attributes.name: firstName
attributes.description: Legal first name of the child.

attributes.name: lastName
attributes.description: Legal last name of the child.

attributes.name: dateOfBirth
attributes.description: Child's date of birth for age verification and grouping.

attributes.name: enrollmentDate
attributes.description: Date when the child was officially enrolled.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current enrollment status (e.g., Active, Inactive, Waitlisted).

attributes.name: medicalNotes
attributes.description: Optional field for allergies, medications, or special medical needs.

core_entities.name: Guardian
core_entities.description: Represents a parent or legal guardian responsible for a child, handling contact and payment authorization.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the guardian.

attributes.name: firstName
attributes.description: First name of the guardian.

attributes.name: lastName
attributes.description: Last name of the guardian.

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary contact email for notifications and communication.

attributes.name: phoneNumber
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number.

attributes.name: relationship
attributes.description: Relationship to the child (e.g., Mother, Father, Legal Guardian).

attributes.name: isPrimaryContact
attributes.description: Indicates if this guardian is the primary contact for emergencies and communications.

core_entities.name: Staff
core_entities.description: Represents an employee or caregiver working at the daycare, with roles and qualifications.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the staff member.

attributes.name: firstName
attributes.description: First name of the staff member.

attributes.name: lastName
attributes.description: Last name of the staff member.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Job role (e.g., Teacher, Assistant, Administrator, Caregiver).

attributes.name: qualifications
attributes.description: Certifications, degrees, or relevant training.

attributes.name: hireDate
attributes.description: Date when the staff member was hired.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Employment status (e.g., Active, On Leave, Terminated).

core_entities.name: Payment
core_entities.description: Represents a financial transaction for daycare services, including fees, due dates, and status.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount due or paid.

attributes.name: dueDate
attributes.description: Date by which the payment is expected.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Payment status (e.g., Pending, Paid, Overdue, Partially Paid).

attributes.name: paymentMethod
attributes.description: Method used for payment (e.g., Cash, Credit Card, Bank Transfer).

attributes.name: paidDate
attributes.description: Date when the payment was actually made, if applicable.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Optional notes regarding the payment, such as discounts or late fees.

core_entities.name: Attendance
core_entities.description: Tracks daily presence of children, including check-in/check-out times and responsible staff.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the attendance record.

attributes.name: date
attributes.description: Date of attendance.

attributes.name: checkInTime
attributes.description: Timestamp when the child was checked in.

attributes.name: checkOutTime
attributes.description: Timestamp when the child was checked out.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Optional notes for the day (e.g., illness, special activities).

key_use_cases.name: EnrollChild
key_use_cases.description: Register a new child in the daycare system, capturing personal details and linking to guardians.

key_use_cases.name: RecordAttendance
key_use_cases.description: Log daily check-in and check-out times for children, with optional notes.

key_use_cases.name: ProcessPayment
key_use_cases.description: Create and update payment records, track status, and record payment methods.

key_use_cases.name: ManageStaff
key_use_cases.description: Add, update, or deactivate staff members, including role and qualification management.

key_use_cases.name: GenerateInvoice
key_use_cases.description: Create invoices for guardians based on attendance, fees, and payment history.

key_use_cases.name: UpdateChildInformation
key_use_cases.description: Modify child details such as medical notes, contact information, or enrollment status.

key_use_cases.name: ViewAttendanceReport
key_use_cases.description: Generate reports on child attendance over a specified period for billing or compliance.

key_use_cases.name: AssignStaffToChild
key_use_cases.description: Link staff members to specific children or groups for caregiving responsibilities.

assumptions: The daycare operates with a fixed schedule (e.g., standard business hours) for attendance tracking.
Payments are primarily handled per child, possibly with monthly or weekly billing cycles.
Guardians may have multiple children enrolled, and a child may have multiple guardians.
Staff roles are predefined and include permissions or responsibilities within the system.
Basic reporting features are needed for attendance, payments, and staff management.
The system will handle sensitive personal data, requiring basic security and privacy considerations.
Communication with guardians (e.g., notifications) is part of the domain but may be implemented via external services.
open_questions: What specific legal or regulatory requirements apply to daycare operations in the target region?
How are late payments, discounts, or refunds handled within the payment process?
Is there a need for grouping children by age or class, and how are staff assigned to these groups?
What types of reports are essential for administrative or compliance purposes?
Should the system support multi-language or multi-currency features for diverse user bases?
How are emergency contacts and procedures integrated beyond guardian information?
Are there integrations with external systems (e.g., accounting software, communication platforms)?
What is the expected scale of the daycare (number of children, staff) to inform system performance needs?
